title: Recusals printed in the 2022-2026 minutes, against the recusal notices on file
question: When the minutes say a commissioner was recused, is there a recusal notice (Form 3209b) from that member for that day?
finding: The 2022-08-17 to 2026-07-09 minutes print 64 meeting days on which a member of the Planning or Historic Preservation Commission was recused from an item; a notice from that member dated that day (or the day either side) is on file for 34. Wright (surname as printed) (Historic Preservation Commission) has the most recused days without a notice (17).
how: Recused names come from the RECUSED line of each action and from action text such as "Commissioners X and Y recused". Notices are the Ethics Commission's Form 3209b file, matched by surname within the body and by date within one day.
limits: The notice is required only for some kinds of conflict (for instance a financial interest under the City's rules); a member recused because of a neighbor's or client's involvement may need none, and a notice may give a different date. Surname matching cannot tell apart two members with the same surname.

columns.t: Days with a notice on file

sources.t: San Francisco Planning: Planning Commission and Historic Preservation Commission minutes, August 2022 to July 2026 (hearing archive; saved by hand 20 Nov 2026)
San Francisco Ethics Commission: notices of recusal, Form 3209b (DataSF)
